name: Public Guestbook (DDC v1)
description: A minimal public guestbook where any visitor can leave a signed message and read all previous messages. Single entity, no relationships, no auth.

context.name: guestbook
context.domain_description: A public guestbook where any visitor can leave a short message with their name and read messages left by others. No accounts, no editing, no deletion.

actors.permissions_description: Anyone can post a message and view all messages. No editing or deletion.

use_cases.name: Sign Guestbook
use_cases.description: Visitor submits a new message with their name and content.

use_cases.name: View Messages
use_cases.description: Visitor views all messages, newest first.

expected_features: Submit a new guestbook message with author name and content
View all messages on the page
Messages display author name, content, and timestamp
unit_tests: POST /api/messages creates a message and returns 201
POST /api/messages rejects empty author_name or content with 400
GET /api/messages returns an array of messages
GET /api/messages returns messages sorted by created_at descending
